Allowed origins: `http://localhost:4200`, any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` (matched via `origin.endsWith(...)`).

To add a new custom domain: edit `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} })` function (around line 21), add a new condition e.g. `origin === 'https://yourdomain.com'` or `origin.endsWith('.yourdomain.com')` to the `if` check. Since Hono's `cors` only matches array entries as exact strings, wildcard subdomains require this function-based approach — see `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4 (CORS)`.
